description: Use when a landlord in England asks what is due for a rented home and when, or wants a plan or calendar for it. Give the postcode and whatever the landlord knows: every other argument is optional. Returns each duty with its status, date, plain explanation and cited rules for the next 12 months, the questions still worth asking (as argument names), and links to an interactive plan and a calendar file. Statuses rely on the landlord's own answers, not documents. Read-only. Nothing is stored. Information, not legal advice.

alarms_tested_at_start.description: Whether the smoke and carbon monoxide alarms were tested on the day the tenancy started

deposit_protected_in_time.description: Whether the deposit was protected and the prescribed information given within 30 days of receiving it

deposit_received.description: The date the deposit was received, often before the tenancy starts, as YYYY-MM-DD

deposit_taken.description: Whether a tenancy deposit was (or will be) taken

epc_expiry.description: The date the EPC expires, as YYYY-MM-DD

epc_rating.description: The EPC's current energy rating, A to G

furnished.description: Whether the landlord supplies any furniture

has_gas.description: Whether the home has any gas appliance, such as a boiler, hob or gas fire

holds_licence.description: Whether the landlord holds the kind of council licence the address needs for this household (the plan's licence question names it); only matters where one is needed

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households. Defaults to single.

last_electrical_inspection.description: The inspection date on the last electrical installation condition report (EICR), as YYYY-MM-DD

last_gas_check.description: The date of the last gas safety check, from the gas safety record, as YYYY-MM-DD

last_rent_increase.description: The date the last rent increase took effect, if there was one during this tenancy, as YYYY-MM-DD

letting.description: now: tenants live there; next: a tenancy is starting, or the home is being got ready to let

licence_end.description: The date the council licence ends, as YYYY-MM-DD

next_electrical_inspection.description: The next inspection date the last EICR sets, which can be sooner than 5 years, as YYYY-MM-DD

postcode.description: Full postcode of the rented property, not the landlord's own, e.g. SW9 7AA

rent_period.description: How often the rent is due

right_to_rent_checked.description: Whether every adult's right to rent was checked before the tenancy was agreed

tenancy_document_given.description: Tenancies from before 1 May 2026: whether the government information sheet (or written terms, for an oral tenancy) was given by 31 May 2026. Later tenancies: whether the written statement of terms was given before the tenancy was agreed. late: given, but after that

tenancy_start.description: The current tenancy's start (letting now) or the next tenancy's planned start (letting next), as YYYY-MM-DD

name: plan_rental
title: Plan a rental's year
